assets.prompt:
Create ONE original finished landscape 4:3 illustration for the Secret Circle party game app. The attached town-square Mafia illustration is the exact STYLE REFERENCE: match its clearly animated polished 3D characters, expressive eyes and eyebrows, adult cartoon acting, believable but stylized clothing, colorful shaped environments, strong staging and soft directional lighting. Keep the same degree of detail as this reference, not a flat toon-shader version, not live-action photorealism and not baby-like cute mascots. Design original characters only. The illustration must explain the game through character action, facial expression, outfit and location. Main faces and decisive gesture clustered in the central 60% of the image for small tile and banner crops. Use a DIFFERENT location, palette and story than the reference. No words, letters, numbers, logos, brands, watermarks, phones, UI, real people, existing franchise characters, alcohol, cups, weapons or violence.

WORD IMPOSTER: A lean emerald-green anthropomorphic chameleon in a fitted plum-purple casual blazer and charcoal mock-neck shirt is seated in a stylish small indoor game lounge with rounded art-deco wall panels and muted emerald-green upholstery, warm brass accent lighting. Medium close-up framing, expressive face in center. The chameleon is confidently improvising a spoken clue, half-lidded eyes glance sideways, one brow raised and an asymmetrical smirk hides uncertainty. It holds ONE clearly BLANK ivory card at upper chest height toward the viewer; free hand makes a restrained conversational gesture. From each frame edge one other cartoon player's hand holds an ivory card with the SAME single gold KEY pictogram on both, showing that the other players know the same secret and our chameleon does not. The two edge cards flank the face, not cover it. Two arms and clean distinct hands on the chameleon. Animated stylized scales as broad simple shapes, not realistic reptile skin. Character face, blank card and matching edge clues readable in a small game tile. Coral and brass warm accent colors against a muted deep green lounge. No detective gadgets, no repeated moonlit village, no added crowd. This is a funny bluffing social game scene.

An original finished 4:3 landscape illustration for a playful social deduction party game, titled Mafia in the app (do not write the title in the image). A fully animated, stylish 3D cartoon scene with strongly simplified sculpted geometry, smooth matte color surfaces, appealing expressive adult cartoon characters, clean readable silhouettes and restrained stage lighting. Same animation universe as the reference chameleon, with far simpler surfaces: all fur and hair made from broad solid sculpted shapes. Visibly animated, cool and witty, suitable for a party game for friends.

A compact cartoon town square at night with chunky curved cobblestones, two simplified crooked navy-blue houses, big warm amber windows, a rounded streetlamp and a simple moon disk. A slim original gray cat in a fitted ink-blue suit and charcoal fedora is secretly whispering to a stocky original weasel in a mustard waistcoat and rolled-sleeve shirt, behind a low rounded brick corner. The cat cups one paw near its mouth, checks the surroundings with a raised brow and intelligent sideways glance. The weasel has a very funny overconfident innocent smile and tense shoulders, pretending nothing is happening. Behind the far side of the corner, an original adult human woman detective with short sculpted swept hair and a dark teal trench coat peeks with a skeptical knowing expression; she has noticed their hidden alliance. Clothes, expressions and gestures clearly suit each role. Strong specific action and funny theatrical staging rather than posed portraits. Main cat/weasel pair large near center, detective smaller on the right, three anatomically coherent figures with clearly separate hands.

Rich violet-blue night palette, mustard and burgundy accents, warm stylized lamplight illuminating faces. Broad graphic background shapes and simple toon shadows, plenty of color even at night. Balanced adult cartoon proportions, expressive smaller eyes, confident character design. Flat large material shapes, smooth sculpted coat and hair masses, no tiny surface detail, no photographic skin or realistic animal rendering. No text, labels, logos, cards, interface or watermark. Original fictional designs only. One unified lively image, readable as a small game tile.

assets.prompt:
Ursprüngliche Generierung:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate ONE original landscape 4:3 game illustration for WORD IMPOSTER, a social bluffing party game.

STYLE REFERENCES: Image 1 (green chameleon, coral graphic backdrop) defines the approved rounded sculpted 3D cartoon world. Image 2 (raccoon with pointing hands) confirms the same rendering, tactile costume details and clear composition. Match that world exactly: expressive eyes, bold eyebrows, rich bright colors, clean soft 3D volume and shaped graphic background. Refine the hero toward a clever grown-up character rather than an infant mascot. No cel shading, 2D drawing, polygon facets or realistic humans. The references are only style guides, not compositions to copy literally.

STORY: all other players know the SAME secret clue; the central chameleon received NO clue and confidently pretends to know it. Tell that through the contrast between matching clue cards and his blank one, plus comic acting.

MAIN CHARACTER: an original emerald/lime-green anthropomorphic chameleon with a clearly reptilian wedge-shaped head, crest, curved neck and coiled tail. Rounded animation shapes, not photorealistic reptile skin. Head is expressive and large but a little smaller relative to the body than image 1. Lean natural reptile torso, no pot belly, baby cheeks or giant pleading pupils. Each eye has an independent sideways glance, one narrow eyelid and a raised eyebrow. A small lopsided closed-mouth smirk conveys "of course I know" while his eyes quietly search a neighbour's card. Clever, cheeky, quick-thinking, slightly caught off guard; not scared, angry or bored.

CLOTHING: a fitted short deep-plum jacket with a standing collar, burgundy lining, rolled cuffs and two small brass snap buttons, over a simple charcoal shirt. Clearly designed seams and collar shapes; no logos or fussy weave. The jacket fits a reptilian body, no human muscular torso. Small green reptile paws with distinct short curved digits, not human palms.

One paw holds ONE large ivory card toward camera against his upper chest: the entire face of this card is completely BLANK. His other paw makes a restrained conversational open-hand gesture as he improvises a clue. Exactly two arms and two attached paws. His curly tail is visible at a lower edge.

At LEFT and RIGHT edges, only a small part of the other players' forearms enters: an amber feline paw on the left and an original ivory/coral segmented robot hand on the right. Each holds ONE ivory clue card facing the viewer. BOTH other cards show the EXACT SAME simple GOLD KEY pictogram, same design and size. The main card stays empty. Cards are clearly separated and do not cover eyes, mouths or other hands. No text or additional symbols on any card.

COMPOSITION: close, slightly asymmetric waist-up framing. The chameleon's face and blank card dominate. His gaze, blank card and two identical clue cards form one clear visual triangle, grouped within the central 75% so the image survives an 8:5 banner crop and reads at 136x104 thumbnail size. All important cards fully within the frame. Little empty space. Strong uncluttered silhouette and spontaneous acting.

BACKGROUND: saturated coral and warm tangerine with just two broad darker coral curved shapes, like the reference's graphic backdrop. Dimensional softly lit character against a simple shaped color field. Clean neutral soft key light, gentle warm edge, no cinematic gold haze, purple lounge, furniture or table. No motion rays needed; the props and face tell the story.

Render polished rounded 3D animation, controlled material detail and pleasing soft volume. No photographic pores, excessive scales, gritty textures, hyperrealistic hair, plasticky shine, huge wet doll eyes, baby proportions, glitter, bokeh, fog, bloom, silhouettes of bystanders, floating signs or symbols. No words, letters, numerals, logos, watermarks, app UI, phones, alcohol, drinking vessels, weapons or recognizable franchise characters. ONE finished illustration only, no collage or style sheet.

Gezielte Augen-Korrektur:
Edit the attached Word Imposter illustration. Make a PRECISE LOCAL CORRECTION TO THE EYES ONLY.

Visible error: the SMALLER EYE ON THE VIEWER'S RIGHT currently contains TWO separate dark irises/pupils, one at each end of its white eyeball. This must become ONE anatomically coherent eye with exactly ONE brown iris and exactly ONE black pupil. Remove the duplicated dark iris/pupil at the far RIGHT edge of that eyeball and reconstruct clean continuous ivory-white sclera in its place. There must be no black remnant, extra eye, pupil, iris, eye socket or dark oval in that corner.

The larger eye on the viewer's left already has ONE pupil. Keep that eye's design and size. Align the corrected right eye naturally with it: both eyes glance slightly toward the viewer's LEFT, with one iris/pupil per eye and a single restrained white catchlight per pupil. The character must have exactly TWO eye sockets, TWO eyeballs, TWO irises and TWO pupils in total, arranged as one normal cartoon pair. No independently wandering/crossed gaze or duplicate reflections that look like extra pupils. Keep the clever, mildly half-lidded and cheeky expression.

Preserve everything else exactly: head and eyebrow shapes, emerald skin and crest, plum jacket and charcoal shirt, grin, curled tail, green paws, blank central card, two identical gold-key cards at the edges, tiger paw, robot hand, coral-orange graphic background, lighting, camera, composition, rounded 3D-cartoon style and landscape 4:3 format. No new objects, symbols, text, watermark or other redesign.
assets.notes: Freigegebene neue runde 3D-Cartoonserie: Chamäleon mit leerer Karte und frechem Blick, zwei gleiche goldene Schlüssel bei Mitspielern, eine Pupille je Auge. 800 × 600 Pixel, 34030 Bytes. Einbau nach konkreter Freigabe; übrige neue Serienmotive weiterhin einzeln freigeben lassen.

prompts.generation:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE cohesive CHARACTER-AND-MATERIAL FOUNDATION SHEET for Secret Circle, an original party-game app. Landscape 3:2.
The attached image of the green chameleon is the SOLE exact ART-STYLE reference. It is not an edit target. Study its precise sculpted head forms, very expressive oversized almond eyes, solid brows, broad curved shapes, plush matte surfaces, restrained tactile detail and clean colorful 3D-cartoon rendering. All subjects on this single sheet must look designed and rendered by the SAME character artist in the SAME production, under the SAME neutral light. This is a casting/model-development sheet, NOT three game illustrations or a collage of different styles.
LAYOUT: one continuous warm-neutral gray studio background and one shared floor, no panel borders, no writing. Two distinct original role-characters stand next to each other, shown from head to mid-thigh at matching scale; small still-life props beside them establish material language.
LEFT: the reference's green chameleon, recognizably the same character design, curled reptilian tail, short purple jacket over dark shirt, reptilian paws, one brow raised and a knowing tight half-smile. Preserve the chameleon skull and muzzle and the characteristic broad surface markings. One iris and one pupil per eye, a consistent deliberate sideways gaze. A blank ivory card is held in one paw.
RIGHT: a stylized ADULT female detective with a memorable sturdy triangular silhouette, medium brown skin, short swept dark hair as a few sculpted masses, a broad blunt cartoon nose, strong expressive sculpted eyebrows, visibly adult jaw and cheek shapes, slightly asymmetrical skeptical closed-mouth expression. Her eyes use the SAME eye-construction language and stylization level as the chameleon's: large clear white shapes, single dark iris/pupil per eye, sculpted lids, shared restrained highlights. She is an animated cartoon person, NOT a pretty realistic human, fashion doll, baby or soft infant. A simple slate-teal trenchcoat with a broad collar, a burnt-orange scarf and plain round buttons communicate detective; no badges, brands, weapons or jewellery. One hand on hip, the other considering a blank card, skeptical glance toward the chameleon. Coherent stylized human hands with five fingers each.
PROPS, on the shared floor or a plain low plinth: a chunky cream blank playing card, a small rounded wooden hourglass with plum frame and amber sand, and a simple folded purple cloth swatch. Props have NO faces or anthropomorphic limbs. The wood, paper, cloth and glass have the same broad modeled forms, soft edge transitions, simplified surface detail and matte 3D-cartoon material treatment as the characters. No food.
Use one soft neutral key light and gentle fill for every subject, equivalent shadow softness, same perspective and shadow treatment, comparable edge sharpness and detail density. Strong shapes and character acting carry identity, not hyperreal textures.
Do NOT make the human more realistic or cinematic than the animal. Do NOT make the props photorealistic product renders. Avoid pores, skin microdetail, textile fuzz, glossy plastic toys, cinematic depth of field, bokeh, dust, fog, magic glow, double pupils, mismatched gaze, extra fingers or limbs. No words, numbers, logos, watermarks, phones, screens, UI, real people, existing franchise designs, alcohol, drinks, violence or weapons.
The result should let an art director judge ONE reusable cartoon world for humans, animals and inanimate objects.

Change ONLY the costume styling and theatrical face makeup to make this an instantly recognizable CLASSIC MIME archetype:

- Replace the rust waistcoat with BLACK SUSPENDERS over the existing bold cream-and-charcoal striped shirt.
- Add a small RED NECKERCHIEF tied close to the neck, not a long scarf.
